value.message: Cartwheels Gym Centre runs Tiny Gym for kids 1 and walking up to 3 years - their site says, with Term 1 Sept 14 to Nov 1, offered several times a week (Mon 9:30/10:15am, Tue 9:45am, plus weekend mornings and weekday evenings). I couldn't pin down the price or registration date. I'll keep watching and text you when those post.
